machines.name: sunxi-orange-pi-3lts
machines.description: Allwinner H6 quad-core Cortex-A53 SBC with 2 GB RAM, Gigabit Ethernet and onboard Wi-Fi/Bluetooth. Boots Pantavisor from an SD card.

machines.name: sunxi-orange-pi-r1
machines.description: Allwinner H2+ quad-core Cortex-A7 router board with dual Ethernet (one via USB) and onboard Wi-Fi. Boots Pantavisor from an SD card.

machines.name: sunxi-bananapi-m2-berry
machines.description: Allwinner V40/A40i quad-core Cortex-A7 SBC with 1 GB RAM, Gigabit Ethernet, SATA and onboard Wi-Fi/Bluetooth. Ships a matching Yocto SDK. Boots Pantavisor from an SD card.

machines.name: imx8qxp-b0-mek
machines.description: NXP i.MX 8QXP B0 Multisensory Evaluation Kit. Delivered as a pv-flash-bundle archive and flashed over USB with the NXP UUU tool rather than as a raw SD image.

machines.name: raspberrypi-armv8
machines.description: 64-bit ARMv8 / AArch64 build for the Raspberry Pi 3 and 4. Ships a matching Yocto SDK. Boots Pantavisor from an SD card.

machines.name: rpi
machines.description: Generic Raspberry Pi machine covering all targets: a multi-kernel multiconfig that builds for every board (Pi 1/2/3/4/5, Zero, Compute Module) across ARMv6, ARMv7 and ARMv8, both 32- and 64-bit. Boots Pantavisor from an SD card.

machines.name: colibri-imx6ull
machines.description: NXP i.MX 6ULL single-core Cortex-A7 SoM on a Toradex carrier board. Delivered as a pv-flash-bundle archive and flashed via the Toradex recovery-mode procedure.

machines.name: radxa-rock5a
machines.description: Rockchip RK3588S octa-core ARMv8.2 SBC (4x Cortex-A76 + 4x Cortex-A55) with up to 16 GB RAM. Boots Pantavisor from an SD card.

machines.name: imx8mn-var-som
machines.description: NXP i.MX 8M Nano quad-core Cortex-A53 SoM on the Variscite Symphony carrier. Delivered as a pv-flash-bundle archive and flashed over USB with the NXP UUU tool.

machines.name: imx8mm-var-dart
machines.description: NXP i.MX 8M Mini quad-core Cortex-A53 SoM on the Variscite VAR-DT8MCustomBoard. Delivered as a pv-flash-bundle archive and flashed over USB with the NXP UUU tool.

machines.name: verdin-imx8mm
machines.description: NXP i.MX 8M Mini quad-core Cortex-A53 SoM on a Toradex Verdin carrier (e.g. Dahlia or the Verdin Development Board). Delivered as a pv-flash-bundle archive and flashed via the Toradex procedure.

machines.name: docker-x86_64
machines.description: Not a flashable board: an x86_64 container image that runs the Pantavisor AppEngine and the pvtest suite under Docker on CI and developer workstations.

machines.name: 96boards-orangepi-i96
machines.description: RDA8810PL quad-core Cortex-A5 96Boards IE board. BSP lives in meta-orangepi-i96; has no Bluetooth and no Wi-Fi AP mode. Boots Pantavisor from an SD card.
